name: Game Jam
description: Deliberately tiny: four pillars, so the tree fits a weekend. Grow it after the jam if the game sticks.

pillars.name: Core Loop
pillars.description: The one thing the player does, over and over, and why it's fun.

pillars.name: Art
pillars.description: Just enough visuals to read the game and set its mood.

pillars.name: Audio
pillars.description: A few sounds and a track that sell the core loop.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.description: Title screen, the minimum HUD and a way to restart.
